sections.kicker: Prepared for Valéria Gontijo + Arquitetos by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your Instagram the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: The work says materiality. The bio says a style category.
sections.keep: The photography. Concrete, timber and light, shot with the same stillness across the grid.

sections.label: Front door
title: Three things people
meet first.
Three things
people meet
first.

pins.what: The bio names a style, with a copyright sign.
pins.why: A named architectural school is shared by many studios. It does not say why this studio and not the one next door.
pins.how: Say what this studio does with material that others do not.
pins.label: Your bio
pins.cost: The studio is placed in a category when its work deserves a signature.

pins.quote: Interiors punctuated by mineral materiality: pure, solid, tactile.
pins.what: One caption holds the real positioning.
pins.why: Mineral materiality, pure, solid, tactile: that is a point of view a client can repeat.
pins.how: Use that sentence as the thread of the profile, not a single post.
pins.label: Your voice
pins.cost: The sharpest description of the studio is read once and forgotten.

pins.area: Each caption stacks Portuguese, English and Spanish text
pins.what: Every caption repeats itself in three languages.
pins.why: It widens the audience, and it makes each post three times longer than the image can carry.
pins.how: Keep one language per post and let the image lead.
pins.label: Your voice
pins.cost: Readers skip the block of text, and the idea inside it with it.

sections.intro: You asked for a look at Valéria Gontijo + Arquitetos. I spent some time on your Instagram. Three things stood out, and all three point the same way.

sections.body: It is 20 minutes with me. We go through this page together, on Valéria Gontijo + Arquitetos's own screens, and you leave knowing what to change first.
sections.note: A few short questions first, then you pick a time. You can also just reply to the email.

reference: Kinfolk, from another category. It sells a way of looking before it sells anything else.
